fields.description: Card processor whose fees fund the top-up (e.g. PayPal).

fields.description: Percentage the processor charges on each top-up (e.g. 2.99 = 2.99%).
fields.label: Processor Fee (%)

fields.label: Processor Fee (Fixed, USD)

fields.description: Flash margin applied on top of processor fees (percent).

fields.description: Flat Flash margin per transaction in USD.
fields.label: Flash Margin (Fixed, USD)

fields.description: Smallest allowed top-up amount in USD.
fields.label: Minimum Top-Up (USD)
